verses.text: You will keep in perfect peace all who trust in you.
verses.title: A Sound Mind

verses.text: Listen to advice and accept discipline, and at the end you will be counted among the wise. Many are the plans in a person’s heart, but it is the Lord ’s purpose that prevails.
The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.
